hints.title: Multi-Article Daily Viewers Identification
hints.text: Find all people who viewed more than one distinct article on the same calendar date, ordered ascending.

hints.title: Composite Grouping and Having Count
hints.text: Group records by view date and viewer identifier, filtering with a having clause where distinct article count exceeds one.

hints.title: Multi-Article Views Query Blueprint
hints.text: select distinct viewer_id as id from Views group by view_date, viewer_id having count(distinct article_id) > 1 order by id asc.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT DISTINCT viewer_id AS id
FROM Views
GROUP BY view_date, viewer_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT article_id) > 1
ORDER BY id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Composite grouping on date and viewer followed by distinct sort runs in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting raw views instead of distinct article identifiers miscounts repeated views of the exact same article.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouped distinct evaluation avoids self-joins on views table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of GROUP BY view_date, viewer_id and HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT article_id) > 1.
